title: (No) Separation of Concerns: Philosophical Concerns about Agent Ethics and Implications for SE Practitioners
abstract: arXiv:2611.31927v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The use of AI agents in software engineering (SE) are commonplace, with differing levels of autonomy, a myriad of capabilities, and ability to perform a variety of tasks. Philosophers have begun to examine the ethics of such agents, and SE researchers or practitioners could benefit from them; on the other hand, SE practitioners currently explore most of these concerns through the lens of principlism. We bridge this gap by reviewing the philosophical literature on AI agents indexed in PhilPapers, and translating its ethical concerns into a research agenda for SE researchers and into implications for teams that use coding agents. A systematic mapping study of PhilPapers -- a major philosophy index and open access archive -- yielded 33 peer-reviewed papers by professional philosophers published since 2023. We coded these papers thematically, with cross-disciplinary review of the emerging themes, resulting in eight themes and 85 codes. From

translated_title: （无）关注点分离：关于智能体伦理的哲学关切及其对软件工程从业者的启示
translated_abstract: 人工智能智能体在软件工程（SE）中的应用已十分普遍，它们具有不同程度的自主性、丰富多样的能力，并能执行多种多样的任务。哲学家们已开始审视这类智能体的伦理问题，软件工程的研究者或从业者可以从中受益；另一方面，软件工程从业者目前主要是通过原则主义的视角来探讨这些伦理关切。我们通过综述PhilPapers数据库中收录的关于AI智能体的哲学文献来弥合这一差距，并将其中的伦理关切转化为面向软件工程研究者的研究议程，以及面向使用编程智能体的团队的实践启示。我们对PhilPapers——一个主要的哲学索引和开放获取档案库——开展了系统性映射研究，共获得2023年以来由专业哲学家发表的33篇同行评审论文。我们对这些论文进行了主题编码，并对涌现的主题进行了跨学科评审，最终归纳出八个主题和85个编码。
tldr: 该研究通过系统性梳理PhilPapers中哲学家关于AI智能体伦理的文献，提炼出八个主题和85个编码，将其转化为软件工程研究议程以及使用编程智能体团队的实践启示。
en_tdlr: This study systematically reviews philosophical literature on AI agent ethics indexed in PhilPapers, distilling eight themes and 85 codes into a research agenda for software engineering researchers and practical implications for teams using coding agents.
